description: Submit a user-authorized job title and responsibilities for a free role-design assessment. Returns findings, a quoted full-report price where available, and a private seven-day link so the human can review the same results. Creates a temporary review snapshot. No card charge, subscription, or paid report is created. An incomplete assessment is not a clean pass. Anyone with the review link can see the submitted text.

confirmed_permission.description: Set true only after the user authorizes sharing this document with Agora Merit.

referral_source.description: Optional integration label for measuring human referrals, such as your public product slug. Never include personal information. Omit when unknown. Use agora_qa for synthetic tests.

responsibilities.description: Responsibilities or duties the user has authorized sharing with Agora Merit. One responsibility per line is helpful.

name: assess_job_responsibilities
